There are always many people at the bus stop. Max learned a lot about art. Max likes windy days best. What's more, the connecting train to Oxford leaves from platform two.
Max hopes to visit Tokyo one day. They took many photos at the bus stop. It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike. In fact, the gearbox needs an oil change.
Max is going to travel to Tokyo in May. Both of them like soup and juice. Eva is interested in cooking. What's more, steam rose from the bonnet.
Max wrote about the day in the diary. The airport is one of the best places in the city. Max bought a hat at the shop yesterday.
